flavor_text: Where nature impedes, Phyrexians overcome.
As the creatures of the night closed in on humanity, Innistrad's primeval forces stirred, as though waking to watch the slaughter.

"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault
The first rebirth is a reward. The fifty-first is a punishment.
It leaves its victims one sting closer to phyresis.
It leaves its victims one sting closer to phyresis.
There loomed against the westward stars a dark black shape: a great barrow stood there.
"If you don't reassemble me immediately, the Mother of Machines will notice my absence, and this entire layer will face her wrath!"
Its webs are not true silk, but woven from thousands of delicate mycosynth strands.
When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.
When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

"Absolute power is the only true authority. Anything less is a lie told by the weak."
—Garruk Wildspeaker
There is a place apart from this world, a rift where pretense falls away and champions find their glory.

"It's a bit much, I know, but it reminds my visitors who really holds the power here."
—Davriel Cane
Durlag's Tower is filled with enough treasure to last a lifetime, and enough traps to drastically shorten that lifetime.
What did you do to the Zero Point?
On the Planet of Sorcerers in the Eye of Terror lies the Tower of the Cyclops, the redoubt of Magnus the Red.

"The war will be decided here, where the planet's defences are strongest."
—Marneus Calgar
In the late stages of a Tyranid invasion, vast capillary towers funnel biomass to the Hive Ships waiting in orbit.
Millions of years of history forged, forgotten, and transformed.
The Hobbits of the Westfarthing said that one could see the Sea from the top of that tower; but no Hobbit had ever been known to climb it.

"I'm not sure who's in charge around here, but I'm pretty sure I know where to go to find out."
—Corliss the Wanderer

"You are a time-space machine. You're a vehicle! I've never asked you to cheer me up with hologrammatic antlers!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

"A thing that looks like a police box, standing in a junkyard... it can move anywhere in time and space?"
—Ian Chesterton
"It's like the Doctor's," said Peri. "But infinitely superior, as I am to that galactic philanthropist," replied the Master.

"Close down the gravitic anomalizer, fire up the helmic regulator. And finally, the hand brake. Ready?"
—The Tenth Doctor

"Corporate felt genetic modification would up the 'wow' factor."
—Claire Dearing

"They're dinosaurs. 'Wow' enough."
—Owen Grady
Cloistered deep in the heart of a distant nebula, the tower awaits its next master.

"Welcome back to my humble abode. Feel free to take a look around."
—Lara Croft

"Hate has no place here."
—Sheldon Menery

"New Vegas is more than a city—it's the remedy to mankind's derailment."
—Mr. House
Any who stand against the tower are soon to lie six feet under it.
Deep in the forests of Valley, there is an ancient batfolk tower with mysterious runes etched into its structure.

"It's me and Gribble's special fort. None of the bad things can get us in there."
—Toby

"You think I sit in this seat because of luck? Because of providence? I hold this seat because I alone am fit to fill it."
—Gonti

"The Wandering teaches us that life is not a binary existence. The body decays, but the mind persists. There must be a reason."
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun
Safe havens amid the desert and dragonstorms, Abzan fortresses attract merchants, travelers, outcasts, and exiles.

"Kefka's practically a god now, sitting up in that tower of his with the power of the Warring Triad at his command..."
—Albrook citizen

"The city lights go out one by one. The stars fade then the horizon glows, almost like it's on fire. It's really... pretty. I know you'd like it."
—Tidus

To dizzying heights it rises, the gleaming spire, its tip threatening to pierce the blinding canopy. There it will all begin anew. Between Dark and Light, the pure and the corrupt—the one true struggle.

"Thanks to the miracle of mako energy, our lives are richer and better than ever before. Mako keeps our lights on at night, and made Midgar into the city that never sleeps."
—Shinra guide

"The servers are the seven Chaos. power enriched by Chaos is power the heart. The controller is the one that unifies the Chaos."
—Tikal's prayer

"Thus, the shattered half of the planet was named Kavaron That Is, and the capital was moved to Kavaron Before."
*—The Tragedy of Emperor Kavarus III*

"What better place to watch over the city than from its greatest heights?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker
The Goblin's real genius, perhaps, was how he hid in plain sight of the city.
"Lay-lah boh Furby boh-dah."

"Wan Shi Tong and his knowledge seekers collected books from all over the world and put them on display for mankind to read, so that we might better ourselves."
—Professor Zei
The boggarts' construction methods were chaotic and reckless, but the resulting tower became the envy of Rotbog warren.

"The Path of Flame is a flamekin's most personal journey. You must walk it for yourself, but you'll never walk alone."
—Zasharua, Brighthearth mentor

"Drive In, Fly Out!"
—Red Rocket Slogan
Back in the '80s, Channel 6 built their headquarters at the corner of Spectacle and Scandal.

"We hope you'll thrive here, and by thriving, prove Strixhaven is the best magical university in existence, capable of meeting the needs of students from across the Planes."
—Kasmina

"On today's tour, you will be allowed into my most secured inner sanctum to see, in the flesh, my newest acquisitions: The Guardians of the Galaxy."
—The Collector

"Of course the Triskelion is a big gaudy target. And anyone who's confident enough to think about taking it out is someone we want on our radar."
—Nick Fury, director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

"Watch your step when in Castle Loki. The architect is a known trickster."
—Loki

"Four Freedoms Plaza is a heckuva name, Stretch. We better make sure we live up ta it."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

"The Royal Palace of Wakanda is more than a home to our royal family. It is a constant reminder of the blessings of Bast that protect our people."
—Changamire, Wakandan philosopher
"I am Rasmodius . . . Seeker of the arcane truths, mediary between physical and ether, master of the seven elementals, keeper of the sacred cha- You get the point."
Behold Avengers Tower, the home of Earth's Mightiest Heroes!
The pinnacle of Jace's hope for a better, different Multiverse.
It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.
After using the signet to finish the miniaturization spell, the novice wizard realized they'd have big shoes to fill.

"To feel no constraint but the four points of a compass, to tread a path that only you can find . . . these are the flavors of power I've learned to savor."
—Keon, horizon walker
Countless xenos cults dwell unseen within the Imperium, lurking just beneath the surface.
As part of their indoctrination and training, a psyker learns to focus their mental strength through a psycho-reactive staff.
All Necrons bear the mark of the Triarch, a brand upon their living-metal skin that binds them to their dynasty.

"Magic rings are, well, magical; and they are rare and curious."
—Gandalf
Matic had only taken the ring to appease his grandmother when she'd pressed it insistently into his palm. As the rats scurried away from its light, he understood her urgency.

"Seal of the High Council of Gallifrey. Nicked it off the Master in the Death Zone."
—The Eleventh Doctor

"Markings on the hilt are faded, but resemble Komon Winaq familial glyphs. Relic recovered for further study."
—Oltec archaeological survey
Preliminary tests showed that the skeleton was as old as the known universe—and that the ring was older still.
Something to love, honor, and cherish— and a reminder of someone who once did that for you.
The dark nights of Valley hold no horrors for batfolk clerics and warriors.
Sometimes safety is a place. Sometimes it's a person. Sometimes it's a tangible reminder that even in darkness, hope persists.
... for Earth's Mightiest Heroes.
Avishkar's power comes from its joyful innovation, in the marvels that people can build when they work together for the common good.
Dozens of empires lie dead and buried in the Broken Lands. But on Amonkhet, dead does not mean gone.
A symbol of power, grace, and unfathomable preciousness.
An official seal authenticating her identity as a very good girl.
Sometimes restoring the lost archives of the Jeskai can be as simple as the quiet ruffle of pages and the smell of fresh ink.

"I preside over the forces of stasis, tranquility, peace. I will weave this selfsame power into the crystal, granting thee mastery over matter, to give form to the formless."
—Hydaelyn

"Lord Kefka's treasure . . . Return the treasure . . ."
—Kefka's cultists

"I'm a blitzball player. Star player of the Zanarkand Abes!"
—Tidus

"To put it simply, the knowledge of the Ancients is sealed within each orb. That knowledge not only connects us to the planet... it allows us to tap into her power."
—Sephiroth

"An ordered Sothera is a peaceful Sothera. Join the Strategic Corps today and proudly turn the gears of progress!"
—Pinnacle recruitment ad
One cannot wear the tiara without cracking a few crowns.

"You chose them from among thousands of toys, Aang. The toys you picked were the four Avatar relics. These items belonged to Avatars past. Your own past lives."
—Monk Tashi
Isilu's adherents invoke its blessings with contemplation at sites marked by standing stones. Where there is quiet, there is the moon's inspiration.
Eirdu's adherents invoke its blessings with jingling bells and dancing feet. Where there is joy, there is the warmth of the sun.
The Brotherhood of Steel seek the dog tags of their fallen brethren, that their deeds may never be forgotten.
The power to draw on the wisdom of your allies at any time, from any place . . . or trade cat pics!
Each Strixhaven graduate receives a class ring bearing the university's motto: "Through study, know the world; through magic, know yourself."

"The Tree of Harmony's magic maintained balance throughout Equestria, protecting us from chaos and darkness."
—Princess Luna

"We are everywhere. We are HYDRA."
—[Name redacted]

"Thing Rings, do your thing."
—Ms. Thing, Darla Deering

"The new ID cards are amazing! Instant communication with any Avenger worldwide, top level security clearance in over a hundred countries, and ten percent off at the cafe downstairs!" -She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

"This royal ring is a small thing, but it is everything. My birthright, the symbol of my home."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

"Stand between the pillars three
With gift as precious as the sky:
A rainbow forged from land, not sea
Then galaxies will heed your cry."
Thráin I came to Erebor and became King under the Mountain. There he found the Arkenstone, Heart of the Mountain.

"Everything is in progress . . . just like us. May we always know exactly who we are."
—Jace, to Tam
"Eat. Sort. Eat. Sort. Eat."
She remembers every breakthrough, from the gene's mutation to the new life's propagation.
Life is ephemeral. Phyrexia is eternal.

"The land has its own intentions, beyond the understanding of those who live on it."
—Nissa Revane
The Cicatrix Maledictum split the galaxy asunder. The raw stuff of Chaos flooded into realspace, transforming whole planets in moments.

"The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule."
—Koth
The earth groaned and quaked. The Towers of the Teeth swayed, tottered, and fell down. The mighty rampart crumbled and the Black Gate was hurled in ruin.

"This lump of rock is suspended in perpetual geostationary orbit around that black hole without falling in. Discuss."
—Ida Scott
A new civilization was built, bit by bit, from the scrap of the old one.
The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.
The House's geography constantly warps and twists, fields melting into floorboards and walls opening into hungry maws.
On the border of the Chaos Wall that separates the Edge from the Blind Eternities, creation itself still churns.
Some say this snarl—the most turbulent, changeable location in all of Arcavios—is the birthplace of the five elder dragons. There are also whispers it's where they are destined to die.

"This is . . . I can't explain it. The opposite of all we know. A negative zone."
—Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
"Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

"Never reject the kindness of a serpent. It will not be offered twice."
—Druidic manuscript fragment

「大蛇の親切は決して拒否してはならない。それは二度と施されることがないのだから。」
—-ドルイドの写本の欠片
Most travelers panic when they stumble upon the skin of a giant rattlewurm. Landry saw it as a gift.
"Now I wonder . . . will anyone come to protect *you*?"
Phyrexia's spiral of consumption grows ever wider and darker.
Metal or flesh, it didn't matter—seasoned with ichor, it all tasted so good.
"Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now."

"Wherever the strong would harm the weak, I will be there."
—Ajani Goldmane

"Stay close, and their wrathful flames will not harm you."
—Galea

"Do not let your hearts be troubled. Even now, there is hope left."
—Galadriel
"I've come a long way for you!" exclaimed the Sixth Doctor. "Naturally. Don't expect any thanks," replied the Second Doctor.

"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine

"You will take nothing, Klaw. Your plunder of Wakanda ends here!"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther
"I just want to do everything in my power to help. All of you... and the planet."

"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist
In the late stages of a Tyranid invasion, sessile organisms take root in a planet's crust, converting its resources into biomass that can be extracted by the Hive Fleet.
Where the rainbow gets its colors and the sun finds its shine.

"The oldest rowan-trees were planted by the Ents to try and please the Entwives; but they looked at them and smiled and said that they knew where whiter blossom and richer fruit were growing."
—Quickbeam
"Architectural Reconfiguration System. It reconstructs particles according to your needs," explained the Doctor. "A machine that makes machines?" Gregor questioned.
Orwell Orchards is about as peaceful and pleasant as a tomb can get.

"When you can't find your way home, find home where you can."
—Rho, veteran hero

"We have been expecting you, Lady Yuna. Welcome to Guadosalam."
—Tromell, Seymour's butler

"Yooo, Rock, check that out. A *mutant* music club?"
—Bebop
In the Blue Area of the moon lies a garden sculpted by alien hands, where the one called the Watcher stands witness.

"Is it the water? The stars? Whatever it is, something incredible is happening here."
—Eris, zoologist, journal entry
As Aclazotz's undead forces approached the temple of Ojer Kaslem, they met a roaring wall of vibrant, flourishing life.
The Master discovered a new evolutionary path after tossing a human, a dog, and a cat into a vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus. He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.
Born in a lab. Raised to be a weapon. Determined to be so much more.
Its blood is life. Its body is growth.
Once revered, then hunted, and now beyond memory.
"I am the primordial guardian of an ancient glade. Please help me find it."

"Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living."
—Auron
They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.
They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

artist: M I N A T O

flavor_text: The travelers were warned to watch out for children on the road.
The dull, creeping pain of phyresis curdled in Vraska's blood. She knew as soon as it took her, she would betray everything—even Jace.
They'll make you miss the mole rats.
In the tight-knit doun of Mistmeadow, death is less important than duty.
Action: Show a kithkin (see pg. 28) emerging from under the ground where he was buried.

"I paid a price to one I will not name to escape the abyss. A bit of my soul for a second chance. And I'd do it again, and again—until I had no soul left to trade."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist
Titania rewards all those who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.
"Name's Flatman. I'm the deputy leader of the Great Lakes Avengers! And I need answers!"
Don't know how I got here, but I'll be the last one standing.
Jagwar, Dreadmon, Leatherhead, Man Ray, Mondo Gecko, Screwloose, and Wingnut. Alone, they could barely save themselves. Together, they could save the world!

"Some deaths you can evade. Others are inevitable."
—*Compendium of Warspells*

「避けられる死もあれば、免れようのない死もある。」
――「戦呪文概要」
Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.
"Thanks to my father, I know how to fight. He also showed me why I must."
They draw upon the strength of their hive and of their victims.

"This one needs a bit longer to ripen."
—Glissa Sunslayer

"Deep into that darkness peering, long I stood there wondering, fearing."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Raven"
"How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."
"How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."
"Once we have claimed this planet, we will claim the stars."

"It's a dangerous business, Frodo, going out of your door. You step into the Road, and if you don't keep your feet, there is no knowing where you might be swept off to."
—Bilbo

"Nine cries for help, nine distress signals, all coming from the same planet."
—The Thirteenth Doctor
Her song twines throughout the Core, a melodic message to all Oltec near and far: you are home.
"Me and Jacob went separate ways after the business with the rig. I went east into the Rockies, looking for other mutants like myself."
For most animalfolk, Valley is a paradise. But among some adventurers, the promise of "somewhere else" is just as captivating.

"I am on a journey, studying the history of our world, Spira, seeking its stories and secrets."
—Maechen, scholar
Eumidians live to change and be changed, ever increasing the complexity of the Edge. Each new world is a new perspective.

"Tallnecks send map data to other machines...but now, it's mine."
—Aloy
Keeper of your discovery! To the jungle of good and plenty!
In the race to be first to the stars, four brave explorers undertook a dangerous journey aboard an experimental spaceship, the *Marvel-1*.
Plasma rifles—separating soft tissues from hard ones since 2077.
Vengeance is a brew best served chilled.
A swarm ever grows in its wake.
At the heart of Ish Sah, Geth stokes the dark fires of Phyrexia.

"Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time."
—Melira
"I give you pain, you give me information. A simple trade, is it not?"

"Urabrask doesn't think big enough."
—Glissa Sunslayer
In the embrace of the Mother of Machines, hard work never goes unrewarded.
Humble, obedient, and tireless, myr require little modification to excel as servants of Phyrexia.
Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.
It took the reclusive Venya Sangmi a lifetime to realize her childhood vision: a band of sunlight made solid.
An arcane device with the power to rouse armies, raze enemies, and reward emperors.
Deep within the heart of the forest, a new sun flared to life.

"Every bead tells a story. They speak of the obstacles we overcome. They speak of the communities we build, the milk we offer our friends, and the land that feeds our people. We weave meaning, tradition, and strength into everything."
Deep within the forsaken cavern, a new shadow emerged to devour the light.
The relic had been kept for years in a place of power, of community, and of friendship—distilling magic from the light of love.

"One day, the dark glory of the void will swallow the light of the stars once and for all!"
—Magus Lucea Kane

"Of all the stars in the Galaxy, Sol is of the Emperor. Its heat is His might. Its light is His revelation."
—*Lectitio Divinitatus*

"As Horus once besieged the Sol System, we shall bring the rotting Imperium to its knees."
—Abaddon the Despoiler

"Once, the C'tan sought to rule us. Now it is they who serve us, their shards powering our great machines."
—Szarekh, the Silent King

In the Second Age, Sauron was not yet evil to behold, and the Elven-smiths of Eregion received his aid and grew mighty in craft, whereas he learned all their secrets, and betrayed them, and forged secretly in the Mountain of Fire the One Ring to be their master.

"Model? I'm insulted. It's by all reasonable metrics a fully functional planetary system, scaled down for easier study."
—Urza, to Tawnos

"The Eye of Harmony. Exploding star in the act of becoming a black hole. Time Lord engineering."
—The Eleventh Doctor
Forged within the star itself, the ring harnesses its stellar energy for an unfathomable purpose.
"What a pretty bauble," thought the cat, extending her paw. "Such beauty belongs on the floor."
"Drop it . . . Drop iiiit . . ."
The Beverageers were pleased by Project Cobalt. Not only did they discover new weaponizable isotopes but a tasty beverage additive to boot.
When the great vault fell, it scattered its wonders across Thunder Junction.
For her birthday, Miku received a gift that shines as brightly as she does.
Strange that an object of pure light can be harnessed to unleash unimaginable darkness.
Water surges in a mysterious crater created eons ago, revered by batfolk as a nexus for the cosmos.

"I'm not saying I'm sure it's a trap. I'm just saying it wasn't there yesterday and I'm pretty sure I heard it whisper my name. If you're so curious, you touch it."
—Angus, survivor scout

"I built this arc reactor to save my life, but I intend to use it to save the world."
—Tony Stark, Iron Man
Bound within this golden ring is the arcane power to purchase tasty treats.
Some cars have a combustion engine, a combustion windshield, and a combustion steering wheel too.

"Nissa asked if the light of foreign suns could affect the flora of Avishkar through Omenpaths. I built a device to capture such light for further testing."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

"Our third sun approaches. Naktamun will remember its masters."
—Varina, monarch of the Broken Lands
Mardu lightning fences are the ingenious synthesis of blacksmith skill and stormsinger magic, protecting their dalkovans from even the most fearsome dragonstorms.
Wear starlight like a crown and dare the moon to dance with you.
It is said that aetheryte is the solid manifestation of the planet's lifeblood, aether, and that by touching it, the aether which makes up our bodies resonates with that contained in the crystal.

"Magicite is an esper's power in its purest form. When an esper dies, magicite is all that's left behind..."
—Ramuh

"Memories are nice, but that's all they are."
—Rikku

"Naturally formed materia. And look at the size of it. Astounding. For the mako energy to condense into something like this, it must have taken an eternity."
—Sephiroth

Sué wanders the sky, hoping to steal a
glance at his love Chia. When we see them
reunite, it is a time for celebration.

"An adventure's no fun if it's too easy."
—Sonic the Hedgehog

"All creation in a single point, the point of all creation in all."
—Sunstar loop-mantra

"Behold my gift to humanity: stable nuclear fusion—the power of the sun!"
—Doctor Octopus, Otto Octavius

"I mostly wear this utility belt to store my extra web-fluid capsules, but check out some of the other neat gadgets I've been able to cram into it!"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"Noo-loo boh way-loos koh may-lahs."

"I'll find you Calypso!"
—Sweet Tooth

"The road ahead of us is challenging. A hundred years of fighting has left the world scarred and divided. But with the Avatar's help, we can get it back on the right path and begin a new era of love and peace."
—Zuko
When Valstrax soars in the sky, it may be the last thing you'll ever see.

"Meadowlarks sing in sun-touched skies
And breezes kiss where Eirdu lies."
—Verselet of Lorwyn

"Wanderers creep 'neath dark moonrise
And wildness seethes where Isilu lies."
—Verselet of Shadowmoor
A companion and a full bowl turn any ruin into home.
Antonio's accommodated every request, asked no questions, and stayed open late. Truly a light in the darkness.

"What drives the star arches to appear, and what causes them to sometimes disappear? I doubt even the Dawning Archaic knows."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

"It's time for you to fulfill your destiny."
—Princess Celestia

"We're gonna need a lot more chlorine."
—Fin, goblin pool technician

"Sometimes a hero has to let everyone know that he's there for them. Sometimes he has to say it with fire in the sky."
—Human Torch, Johnny Storm

"The subject of innovation will always be near and dear to my heart."
—Tony Stark

"The mantle of the Black Panther is not taken lightly, my son. Power is a burden, and the king is ever a servant."
—King T'Chaka
It was not the first time Doom had cackled triumphantly upon completing an instrument of global domination. But this time felt different.

"If we align the aether just so . . ." mumbled Saheeli.
"And we adjust for the flow of mana . . ." added Breya.
"That's it!" they exclaimed in unison as their vision sprang to life.
Jace could see the sunlight in his Multiverse, but somewhere along the way, he lost the feel of its warmth.
"Okay, suckers—you've taken your best shot! Now it's my turn!"
"Try one! They're disgusting!"

"The Tree was the heart of our world. It made me what I am and pulled me back from the brink of death. I won't allow it to be forgotten."
—Esika, god of the Tree

"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

"Radagast is, of course, a worthy Wizard, a master of shapes and changes of hue."
—Gandalf

"Do you recognize them? The Chagaskas. Your worst fears, my creativity."
—Zellin
Beasties tend to be shy, kind to humans, and absolutely ruthless toward Valgavoth's monstrous spawn.
Raw vibranium is hazardous to any who touch it, causing irreversible mutations.

"Fyndhorn is our home."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

"It is in our nature to recognize beauty, but to repeat it—ah, that is another feat altogether."
—Hannah of Verdura
Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

"Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us."
—Arathel, elvish queen
"Greetings, tired traveler."
Druidcraft is a simple invocation to spirits of nature, promising a glimpse of nature's secrets.
From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.
For years Wakanda hid in isolation, but now alongside newfound allies, it grows and flourishes.

"The spirits that return to the planet, merge with one another and roam the planet. They roam, converge, and divide, becoming a swell, called the lifestream."
—Bugenhagen

"How can you build a better future without first looking to the past?"
—Queen Mother Ramonda
Feel the joy of losing yourself to feed the land.

"All elves aspire to be part of nature. Only Phyrexia can truly grant that wish."
—Glissa Sunslayer

"'The name of it,' said the lady, 'is Excalibur.'"
—Sir Thomas Malory, *Le Morte d'Arthur*

"Let me tell you why you must never close your eyes when on watch. Not even for a second."
—Jor Kadeen
"It's about time we did something fun together."
Nano-infectant: A category-Phi substance, capable of infecting both organics and artificials. Weaponizing it is a war crime.

"Watch your footing around here. Anything you might step on probably has teeth."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

"I've never *heard* growth before."
—Gowon, Femeref herder
Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.
Nature grows solutions to her problems.
Lord Windgrace dedicated his life to restoring Urborg to its former glory.
Upon impact with a planet's surface, a tyranocyte's bloated belly bursts open, disgorging a horde of Tyranid invaders.
All through the winter Sam remained as patient as he could. Spring surpassed his wildest hopes.
Freed from human industry and sheltered from nuclear destruction, Appalachia's plant life finally had a chance to flourish.

"It is up to the planet to decide. What is best for the planet. What is bad for the planet. All that is bad will disappear."
—Bugenhagen
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
"The black lotus rises from adverse conditions and produces a rare bloom. We grow the lotus to remind us to look to the future despite the suffering of the present."
